description: Endpoint Central is an IT management platform that helps organizations manage their endpoint infrastructure from a single console, covering the full device lifecycle from provisioning to retirement.IT teams automate patch deployment across operating systemsand third-party applications, distribute software remotely, manage mobile devices, troubleshoot endpoints through built-in remote access tools, and monitor digital employee experience to identify and resolve performance issues proactively. The platform supports Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, and Chrome OS.Security capabilities include vulnerability assessment, application control, endpoint privilege management, device control, disk encryption management, EDR, NGAV protection, and private access for secure remote connectivity.Available as on-premises or cloud deployments across five editions: Free, Professional, Enterprise, UEM, and Security, giving organisations the flexibility to scale as their requirements grow.
